title: Sensitive subjects

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Represent sensitive subjects clearly without exposing people because both privacy and interpretation shape the effect of an image.
strategic_value: Indirect, concrete storytelling can help Helsinki communicate care without reducing residents to clichés.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section combines guidance on anonymity, image/text interpretation and outcome-led subjects with examples of sensitive-topic imagery and symbolic clichés.
practical_value: Choose a concrete subject, protect recognizability where needed and use accompanying text to clarify meaning.

content_islands.name: Privacy approach
content_islands.spec: Describe distance, depth of field, motion and reflections as ways to protect clients.

content_islands.name: Interpretation examples
content_islands.spec: Pair sensitive-topic images with captions explaining ambiguity.

content_islands.name: Outcome-led examples
content_islands.spec: Contrast clear results and everyday feelings with clichéd symbolism.

ingredient.name: Sensitive-topic imagery
ingredient.role: Communicate difficult subjects while protecting dignity and clarity.
ingredient.application: Use indirect viewpoints or illustration where appropriate; make the intended meaning concrete and reinforce it with text.
ingredient.scope: The section recommends professional consultation for illustration/storyboards; no camera settings or blanket anonymity rule for all photographs are specified.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains that viewers interpret images differently and that supporting text can reduce misinterpretation.
reference_purposes.Application: It offers concrete photographic techniques and illustration as approaches for sensitive subjects.
